thread:
mira.design: Quick loop on the first-run surface — I pushed two variants to staging: Starter Step (compact checklist) and Rail Quickstart (persistent right rail). Pls skim and drop feedback. https://staging.console.redwood-inference.com/onboard/preview :eyes:
alex_pm: Taking a look rn. What's the main metric we're targeting? completion rate or time-to-first-call?
devon_devex: completion rate first, but we also want to measure % who create an API key within the flow.
mira.design: Right — primary is completion rate, secondary is api-key creation. UX hypothesis: persistent rail helps discoverability but risks noise. Checklist is lower friction for quick users.
sam_access: Accessibility note: the rail needs proper skip link and focus trapping avoided. Keyboard users should be able to tab into the rail and out without getting stuck. Also add `aria-describedby` for the sample card list.
lee_frontend: Good call. On staging I added `tabindex="0"` to sample cards, but that might be wrong. I'll swap to `<button>` wrappers and ensure correct role.
mira.design: Example copy candidates for the rail CTA — short ones please: Option A: "Try a sample project — 1 click to run" Option B: "Start with a sample project" Option C (concise): "Run a sample" Thoughts?
alex_pm: A or C. A implies speed which is good. Maybe shorten to "Run a sample project — 1 click"
devon_devex: For the checklist header copy: current is "Get started — setup checklist" — feels dry. Suggest "Get your first inference running" or "Set up your first model".
sam_access: For screen reader users the rail CTA should include context: add visually-hidden text like "Opens sample project in current workspace" to avoid confusion.
lee_frontend: Also found an issue: opening a sample triggers a modal that steals focus but doesn't restore to the rail close button on dismiss. I'll file a bug and hotfix it.
mira.design: Screenshot of the Rail Quickstart variant: https://imgur.com/a/fake-screenshot (placeholder) — note the contrast on the CTA is 3.8:1 right now. Need 4.5:1 for small text.
alex_pm: We should raise the CTA color or bold the text. Which is less disruptive to the brand?
lee_frontend: I can bump the bg to the darker teal token — quick PR. Also will add `aria-live="polite"` region for the checklist progress updates.
devon_devex: Can we avoid showing the whole checklist if user is on a tiny screen — maybe collapse into progress pill? Mobile real estate is tight.
mira.design: Yes — responsive: rail collapses to a floating quickstart chip that expands on tap. Design spec: collapsed height 48px, expands to full checklist. I'll add to the staging spec.
sam_access: One more a11y nit: color-only indicators for step completion — add an icon + text for colorblind users.
mira.design: Agreed. I'll update the mocks. Also adding tracking events: `onboard.start`, `onboard.sample_open`, `onboard.api_key_created`. devon, can you wire the analytics?
devon_devex: Yep, will add those and log time-to-event.
lee_frontend: Quick snippet for keyboard focus handling I plan to use:
```
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key === 'Tab') {
    // ensure focus cycles naturally between rail and main content
  }
});
```
I'll replace with roving tabindex pattern in the PR.
mira.design: Final ask: can folks review copy in the PR? I'll post the copy doc in #design-assets and tag reviewers. Ping me if you spot anything blocking for release. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: New deploy to staging: onboard/rail-variant @ 2024-10-12T15:04:23Z :white_check_mark:
alex_pm: Quick thumbs: I'm leaning rail for now if we can meet the contrast/focus fixes. If not, default to checklist. Either way, let's A/B test for 2 weeks. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
mira.design: Perfect — will set up the experiment and share tracking plan. Thanks all!
